finalText:
Build is green now (exit 0). Root cause: the bundler bump changed the shape of options handed to modules.

- `src/core/options.js:7` — still read `options.retries` but the new bundler passes `retryCount`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw on `undefined`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the strict boolean check only accepted `true`/`false` and threw otherwise. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled, same as `false`.

The remaining ~950 lines of `WARN DEP0xxx` deprecation notices and `note:`/`dedupe:` chatter are just noise from the new bundler version (8 warnings reported in the final summary) — not actionable, build now completes cleanly with 0 errors.
